scope: Navisworks source objects relevant to S5 coordination, S6 federation/coordinates, and S7 deliverables

sources.title: JSON - Navisworks Export Settings
sources.notes: The five source instructions are represented in the current L6 instruction without inventing unresolved preset values.

sources.title: S5 – Navisworks Project Setup for Coordination
sources.notes: Project-setup governance is represented as a bounded S5/S6 standard and connected workflow.

sources.title: S5 – Navisworks Clash Detection Matrix – Standard Setup
sources.notes: Matrix governance and required metadata are represented without inventing discipline pairs or numeric tolerances.

sources.title: Navisworks Federation & Coordination Standards
sources.current_main_match: TIVERIT-BIM-STD-S5-NAVISWORKS-PROJECT-SETUP-001 + S6 shared-coordinate standard + Navisworks conformance tests
sources.notes: Mature federation principles are represented in governed setup/coordinate objects and conformance tests. Exact append toggles, thresholds, folder maps, owners, and other TODO content remain unresolved project/configuration data and are intentionally not promoted.

sources.title: Metadata and Export Settings for Navisworks
sources.notes: The page explicitly points to the JSON export source as the governed values basis. Proposed profiles and unresolved exact settings remain draft evidence.

sources.title: ACC Model Coordination vs Navisworks – Clash & Issue Workflows
sources.notes: System-of-record, issue traceability, meeting, verification, and sign-off boundaries are represented. Draft tool-preference language is not elevated into enterprise doctrine.

sources.title: Metadata and Deliverables Standards for Navisworks
sources.notes: The source output taxonomy is preserved, while deliverable/record status is derived from governed S7 purpose/state rules rather than unresolved draft folder paths, retention durations, or example classifications.

sources.title: Gaps in Navisworks
sources.notes: The historical seven-gap list remains source evidence. Each gap now has an explicit repository disposition; unresolved project/configuration values are no longer treated as migration omissions.

remaining_non_migration_dependencies: project-specific numeric clash tolerances and discipline-pair matrix values
project/client-specific export preset values and exporter-version configuration
project-specific CDE folder paths and retention durations
project/BEP/RACI authority assignments where the source leaves owner or approver unresolved
closure.rule: These dependencies are configuration or project-governance inputs, not missing Confluence migration objects.

rules: Source DRAFT or TODO content is not promoted as final authority.
Existing current-main objects are enriched or referenced rather than duplicated.
Numeric tolerances, exact clash pairs, folder paths, exporter toggles and owner roles are not invented when the source leaves them unresolved.
